sentences.text: "Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Kshitij Pal Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

Learned Additional District & Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Muzaffar Nagar is directed to submit the status of Special Sessions Trial No. 586/9/2021 (State Vs. Vinod and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 342 of 2020, under Sections 363,
376 I.P.C. and 5e/6 Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, PS Mansoorpur, District Muzaffar Nagar within two weeks.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Muzaffar Nagar
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Special Sessions Trial No. 586/9/2021 (State Vs. Vinod and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Registrar (Compliance) is directed to communicate this order to the district judge concerned for ensuring compliance.
5. Pursuant to the order of this Court dated 14.8.2024, Learned Additional District & Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Muzaffar Nagar has submitted the report.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO Act), Muzaffar Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the said report, it is stated that accused is not cooperating in trial and his counsel did not appear for cross examination from witnesses PW 2 Amit Kumar, P@-3 Gaurav Kumar, PW-4 Constable Kavita Jayant.
4. Further, being confronted by the Court, learned counsel for the applicant except the pendency of trial, could not establish any new ground for enlarging the applicant on bail.

5. Learned AGA has vehemently opposed the third bail application and submitted that applicant is habitual offender and indulged in so many criminal activities, therefore, no case is made out for enlarging the applicant on bail.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the gravity of the offence, the nature of accusations and severity of punishment in case of conviction, there does not appear any new good ground to release the applicant on bail.
7. Accordingly, the second bail application is rejected.

8. Keeping in view that the applicant is in jail since 21.12.2020, the trial court is directed to make all possible efforts to conclude the trial expeditiously, if possible, within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Order Date :- 9.1.2025
